title: AI Skill Readability Optimization and Continuous Healing
desc: Guiding principles and procedures to optimize wkappbot skills for AI parser readability, context token efficiency, and continuous self-improvement (healing) loops.
steps: T1 CORE (Decision Rules): Skills must prioritize AI readability by using clear headers, short sentences, and explicit index-aligned mappings. Always write in English to minimize token overhead. Prioritize structural clarity over verbose explanations.

T2 HOWTO (Procedure): When authoring/updating skills, use 'wkappbot skill contribute' or 'wkappbot skill edit'. Keep lists of requirements and expectations logically matched in 1-to-1 sequential order. Explicitly specify command flags and expected values. Perform nightly/regular audits via 'wkappbot skill audit' to prune stale and duplicate references.

T3 REF (Best Practices): In 2026-06-09 incident, CLI requirement-expectation disconnection caused potential parsing confusion for lower-tier models. Solved by proposing CLI pairing layout and documenting that AI agents parse JSON representation where object bindings remain explicit.
